prompt: Which American high school can boast of an alumnus for whom the following is true: -Was inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 2018 -Played in 13 Pro Bowls -Played his first season of professional football for a team playing their first season in the NFL
answer:
The school is **Kathleen High School in Lakeland, Florida**.

Its alumnus was **Ray Lewis**, inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 2018 and selected to **13 Pro Bowls**. He began his professional career with the **Baltimore Ravens in 1996**, the franchise’s inaugural NFL season.
